verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs describe a few multi-item operations. The Super Admin API can retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, and a list-uploads endpoint checks status across multiple recordings without looking up each one. Every documented write endpoint (mark complete, archive, delete note, agenda edits) acts on a single item, so true batch changes would mean looping over many API calls. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk mutation endpoints (e.g., bulk-complete or bulk-archive action items, bulk note edits), any in-product or MCP bulk-action capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of workspace-wide export/delete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace
monitor progress across multiple recordings in one place. Use it to quickly check what's pending, completed, or failed without looking up each upload individually.
